; Removed false positives (data misidentified as CALL targets):
; 0x087B -- TMR1 sound variable in RAM, not code
; 0x0C08 -- in RAM gap between ROM0 and ROM1
; 0x3C2B -- bytes in difficulty table at $37F7 (data, not instruction)
; 0x4262 -- font data bytes for character 'b' at $3290
; 0x7FFF -- LD HL operand at $29D4 and sound data bytes at $3593
; 0x9503 -- sound data bytes at $3531 (not real CALL PE)
; 0x9F02 -- sound data bytes at $3535 (not real CALL PO)
; 0xF41D -- jump table data bytes at $1D49 (not real CALL PO)
